title: README dev command has a typo: `pm run dev`
evidence: README.md:21 shows `pm run dev` instead of `npm run dev`
suggestion: Fix the copy/paste typo to `npm run dev`

title: SQLite database is in-memory only (not durable)
evidence: src/index.ts:9 `new sqlite3.Database(':memory:')` — data is lost on restart
suggestion: Use a file-backed SQLite database if persistence across restarts is desired; in-memory still satisfies R7 (real SQLite engine, not a plain array)

title: `year || null` coerces a legitimate year of 0 to null
evidence: src/index.ts:39 and :85 use `year || null`, so year=0 (and empty isbn strings) become null
suggestion: Use `year ?? null` to only null out undefined/null values
